notes: Stories created for Mongo query size estimation with clear separation of contract, logic, integration, and testing.

BL-0.1.4-009-S1.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
BL-0.1.4-009-S1.description: Define a standard schema and contract for estimating Mongo query size including document count, projected payload size in bytes, and enforcement thresholds aligned with GPTReader limits.

BL-0.1.4-009-S2.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
BL-0.1.4-009-S2.description: Build core logic to estimate Mongo query response size prior to execution using document sampling or metadata (e.g., avg doc size * limit) and enforce caps such as 500KB and 100-document limits.

BL-0.1.4-009-S3.title: Integrate Size Guard into GPTReader Query Pipeline
BL-0.1.4-009-S3.description: Integrate the size estimation and guard logic into GPTReader so that oversized queries are rejected or truncated before execution, with clear error handling and audit logging.

BL-0.1.4-009-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Enforcement
BL-0.1.4-009-S4.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, enforcement of size limits, rejection of oversized queries, and safe handling of edge cases such as large documents or unbounded queries.

BL-0.1.4-009.mitigation: Use conservative estimation heuristics and enforce hard caps already defined in GPTReader.
